name: Einomaru Miyu
source:
A watchman from his hometown who has helped the protagonist.
Her true identity is a girl who dreams of becoming the strongest idol.
Aim to become the No. 1 idol of the apocalyptic world with agile movements, singing skills, and two pistols!

A background character in the base game become a heroine in the Isol song expansion.
